title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: front-of-room display defaults to attendee view in webinars and structured meetings
summary: The briefing's default display behaviour, Teams Rooms Pro requirement and rollout dates are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. There is one minor table omission: the guidance describes the presenter's console view switch, but the table records only the absence of an administrator control.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: A Teams Rooms on Android device invited as a presenter in a webinar or structured meeting defaults its room display to attendee view.
claims.quote: This change ensures that when a Teams Room joins as a presenter, the in-room display defaults to the attendee view

claims.claim: Attendee view lets in-room participants see the event as attendees would on their personal devices.
claims.quote: When you add an MTR as an attendee, attendees in the room will be able to see the event on the room display just as it would appear on their personal devices.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The default attendee view hides green room and backstage presenter controls from the in-room audience.
claims.quote: In-room audiences will not see presenter tools such as Green Room or backstage controls.

claims.claim: Presenters retain full control from the Teams Rooms console.
claims.quote: Presenters always have full control from the console

claims.claim: Presenter console controls include green room management.
claims.quote: Managing Green Room and off-stage participants.

claims.claim: Presenter console controls include managing off-stage participants.
claims.quote: Managing Green Room and off-stage participants.

claims.claim: Presenters can switch the front-of-room display to presenter view without affecting attendees.
claims.quote: can switch the front-of-room display to presenter view without impacting attendees.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Teams Rooms console has Switch to presenter view and Switch to attendee view buttons that change the room display view.
claims.quote: To switch views, select Switch to presenter view or Switch to attendee view on the MTR console.

claims.quote: In presenter view, the front-of-room display will show the live event feed, the event chat, and meeting controls. It will also show the Manage screen queue where presenters are brought on and off screen

claims.claim: Presenter view shows a red square around the live feed to mark what attendees currently see.
claims.quote: as well as a red square around the live feed to indicate what attendees are currently seeing.
